The '''Glacial Fissure''' was the name applied to the region surrounding a volcanic rift on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] whose proper name was [[White Maw Pass]]. The term "Glacial Fissure" applied to the region between the [[Tromper Crags]], the eastern border of [[Highmount Ridge]], and the [[Starship Graveyard (Hoth)|Starship Graveyard]] to the west. The [[Crystal Wastes]] to the south of White Maw Pass was also considered part of the area.

The fissure was home to [[Geo Beast]]s whose [[Brain/Legends|brains]] were harvested as a [[Geo Beast Brain|delicacy]] and used during the [[Feast of Prosperity/Legends|Feast of Prosperity]].<ref name="Brains">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=daily|Prep Work: Larval Geo Beast Brains|Hoth}}</ref>
